summary: Feed s072_single is degraded: IDS requires VLANs 10, 20 but 100% of packets arrive untagged. All other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, one-way, drops, overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/TAP uplink is stripping 802.1Q tags before delivery. 100% untagged packets while VLANs 10 and 20 are required indicates egress port to IDS is configured as access/untagged or broker is set to strip tags, rather than trunk/tag-preserve.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot attribute traffic to VLAN 10/20 security zones. VLAN-dependent detection rules, segmentation policy and lateral-movement correlation will fail, creating complete blind spot for those VLANs despite IDS needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve 802.1Q tags end-to-end from TAP/SPAN through packet broker to IDS so VLAN 10,20 identifiers are delivered intact for correct classification and detection coverage.
